c4isr_products.name: RAIC (Rapid Automatic Image Categorization)
c4isr_products.description: AI platform that lets a non-expert search, label and build object detectors across very large unlabeled imagery/video sets from a single example (few-shot / embedding-similarity search), avoiding months of manual labeling. Marketed for satellite, drone, ISR video and industrial inspection.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: satellite/aerial/drone imagery and FMV (e.g., Planet imagery). Process: imagery embeddings, unsupervised clustering, similarity search, rapid detector creation. Output: detections, labels, searchable imagery, change detection. User: GEOINT/ISR analysts, imagery scientists.
